notes: Fixed the top header bar's Import ASUP/Refresh/status-badge group (.header-status) jumping to the far LEFT edge of the header whenever the search box is hidden -- which happens specifically on the Settings tab (switchTab() sets .search-box to display:none there). .top-header uses justify-content:space-between between exactly two flex children (.search-box and .header-status); with only one child visible, space-between collapses to flex-start, yanking .header-status (and the Refresh button inside it) to the left edge, where it could land under/behind the Settings page's first hero card. Fixed with margin-left:auto on .header-status, which pins it to the right regardless of how many sibling flex items are visible -- a spec-guaranteed flexbox behavior, not dependent on which tab is active.
